stages.name: Tidewater Plaza
stages.blurb: A Victorian seaside square: fight round the Jubilee clock tower, under the colonnade and along the promenade.

stages.name: Kelpline Terminal
stages.blurb: A container terminal at shift change: a gantry crane straddles the pier between two moored ships. Mind the water.

stages.name: Halyard Marina
stages.blurb: Floating docks, a tug on blocks and a car ferry moored across the middle. Mind the water.

stages.name: Saltpan Basin
stages.blurb: An open salt works: sunken pans and boardwalks round a wind pump, with the shed roof and salt heap as high ground.

stages.name: Crossroads Market
stages.blurb: Narrow shop streets and an iron gallery close in on the glass Market Hall, where the No. 3 tram waits under the clock.

stages.name: Lockgate Canals
stages.blurb: Drained locks through a brick warehouse district: the canal splits the map, so hold the bridge and the gates.

stages.name: Terrace Heights
stages.blurb: A whitewashed hill village: hold the terraces, fight for the stairs and drop in on the Piazzetta.

stages.name: Cargo Terminal
stages.blurb: A container terminal at shift change: a gantry crane straddles the pier between two moored box ships.
